messages:
frank: putting up a composite-sentinel gate for rwd-v6-hybrid-int4. goal: reduce false rollbacks by requiring signal consensus across metric families (quality, hallucination, perf). plan: micro-shadow 20m -> 1% -> 4% -> 15%. sharing draft.

maya: love consensus idea. propose require 2 independent families on 1% step: (MRR relative drop) + (HALLUC_PP absolute increase) OR (TOKENS_PER_SEC drop). for >=4% single-family hard-fail is OK.

mira: add slice min-samples and an explicit "insufficient_data" state so slices <min_samples don't count. longform should be thresholded higher and longer window (45m).

frank: snippet for console ingestion:
```
rollout_id: RL-20260330-99
model: rwd-v6-hybrid-int4
sequence:
  - micro_shadow: 00:20:00
  - steps:
      - percent: 1
        duration: 00:12:00
        require_concurrent_families: 2
      - percent: 4
        duration: 01:00:00
      - percent: 15
        duration: 01:20:00
auto_fallback:
  families:
    - name: quality
      metrics: [MRR]
      warn_pct: 0.6
      rollback_pct: 1.6
    - name: hallucination
      metrics: [HALLUC_PP]
      warn_pp: 0.2
      rollback_pp: 0.5
    - name: perf
      metrics: [LATENCY_P95, TOKENS_PER_SEC]
      rollback_ms: 40
      rollback_pct_tokens: 18
slices:
  - name: core
    metric: MRR
    min_samples: 2500
    eval_window: 10m
  - name: longform
    metric: MRR
    min_samples: 5000
    eval_window: 45m
general:
  min_samples_per_step: 2000
  require_concurrent_families_for_small_steps: true
  preflight_smoke_queries: 1000
```

maya: add warning webhook to #canary-eyeballs and hard-fail to #sre-watch. also add eval windows per-step (10m) and longform 45m.

rollout-bot: RL-20260330-99 drafted in staging. manual start at /console/rollouts/RL-20260330-99.

ops-bot: tagging ops for 3h watch window. I'll escalate if queue depth > 450 or tokens/sec drop sustained > 12% for >5m.

frank: action items: mira export slice defs + insufficient_data handling (ETA 25m), maya wire webhooks (ETA 20m), frank to run preflight smoke then kick micro-shadow (ETA 50m). will auto-rollback on hard-fail and follow up with postmortem.
